scope: Focused primary-source overlap screen, not an exhaustive novelty or priority claim

sources.title: Computing a Trust Region Step
sources.authors: Jorge J. More and D. C. Sorensen
sources.overlap: Quadratic minimization under ellipsoidal constraints and a secular-equation solver are established numerical optimization.
sources.consequence: Do not claim the inner ellipsoid solver or its multiplier equation as a new theorem.

sources.title: Robust Solutions to Least-Squares Problems with Uncertain Data
sources.authors: Laurent El Ghaoui and Herve Lebret
sources.overlap: Bounded-uncertainty minimax least-squares formulations and robust regularization.
sources.consequence: Decision-space renderer uncertainty is an application hypothesis; minimax treatment of an ellipsoid is not new by itself.

sources.title: Exploring patterns enriched in a dataset with contrastive principal component analysis
sources.overlap: Contrastive covariance structure and eigendirections that emphasize signal relative to a background distribution.
sources.consequence: A signal-versus-renderer-error eigenspace alone is not sufficient mathematical novelty.

sources.title: UniTexture: Cross-Task Universal Adversarial Textures for Vision-Language-Action Models
sources.overlap: A shared object-bound texture is optimized across tasks with explicit native action-space targets.
sources.consequence: Direct action-MSE must be a baseline; merely replacing feature displacement with an action objective is already occupied.

sources.title: Action Robust Reinforcement Learning and Applications in Continuous Control
sources.authors: Chen Tessler, Yonathan Efroni, Shie Mannor
sources.overlap: Control under additive or alternative adversarial action uncertainty.
sources.consequence: Uncertainty in a control action is an established setting, although here the uncertainty models a renderer discrepancy rather than an actuator adversary.
